statement.p: Consider the vector field shown below.

p.em: (Note: For the vector field, vectors are shown with a dot at the tail of the vector.)

statement.p: Let C_1 be the line from (0, 0) to (-1, 1), C_2 be the line from (0, 1) to (-1, 0), and C_3 be the semi-circle centered on the origin that goes from (0, 1) to (0, -1) in a counterclockwise direction.
Is the line integral of the vector field along each of these curves positive, negative or zero?

Along C_1, the integral is
?
positive
negative
zero

Along C_2, the integral is
?
positive
negative
zero

Along C_3, the integral is
?
positive
negative
zero

static.solution: C_1 is zero, the line integral along C_2 is positive, and the line integral along C_3 is zero.
